purpose: Observe complete original-time stereo band envelopes over longer approved contexts. Preserve deterministic trends and cross-band/LR dependence before designing a generative detail law.

features.order: band-major, L then R;10log10 channel power
features.trend: OLS intercept and linear native time, no audio processing. Residual is descriptive, not certified random detail.
features.normalization: population covariance divide by number of windows; lagged product divide by available pairs, retain sign and direction
features.HF_summary: bands3..14k; mean normalized per-channel dB trace, same feature covariance and literal eigenvalues; no forced rank, no runtime profile

known.rising_carriers: f0 +100t Hz for each carrier; no random AM, all remain inside declared HF bands
known.analytic_check: per-HF-band Hann-squared weighted amplitude products and exp(-i phase_R)/2; zero/steady/all deterministic carriers also independently rebuilt

limits: Two contexts from one video, not independent recordings
No physical RPM/load/fueling or continuously calibrated gear from envelopes
Native frequency bands include harmonic motion, wind, microphone and source effects
Linear detrending does not identify stochastic mechanical modulation
No stationarity claim or universal VAR fit from three-second contexts
No additive noise qualification, automatic widening or new strength sweep
